question: Who were Niels Bohr's doctoral students?
sql: SELECT s.qid FROM edges_advised e JOIN nodes_person a ON a.qid=e.advisor JOIN nodes_person s ON s.qid=e.student WHERE a.name='Niels Bohr'
gold_cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Niels Bohr'})-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person) RETURN s.qid, s.name

question: Which doctoral students of Arnold Sommerfeld won the Nobel Prize in Physics?
sql: SELECT s.qid FROM edges_advised e JOIN nodes_person a ON a.qid=e.advisor JOIN nodes_person s ON s.qid=e.student WHERE a.name='Arnold Sommerfeld' AND s.qid IN (SELECT DISTINCT e.person FROM edges_award e JOIN nodes_award a ON a.qid=e.award JOIN nodes_person p ON p.qid=e.person WHERE a.label='Nobel Prize in Physics')
gold_cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Arnold Sommerfeld'})-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(w:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) RETURN DISTINCT s.qid, s.name

question: Who shared a doctoral advisor with Werner Heisenberg?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT e2.student FROM edges_advised e1 JOIN nodes_person h ON h.qid=e1.student JOIN edges_advised e2 ON e2.advisor=e1.advisor JOIN nodes_person s ON s.qid=e2.student JOIN nodes_person a ON a.qid=e1.advisor WHERE h.name='Werner Heisenberg' AND s.name<>'Werner Heisenberg'
gold_cypher: MATCH (h:Person {name:'Werner Heisenberg'})<-[:ADVISED]-(a:Person)-[:ADVISED]->(s:Person) WHERE s.qid <> h.qid RETURN DISTINCT s.qid, s.name

question: How many academic descendants does Arnold Sommerfeld have within three generations?
sql: WITH RECURSIVE d(q, depth) AS (SELECT e.student, 1 FROM edges_advised e JOIN nodes_person a ON a.qid=e.advisor WHERE a.name='Arnold Sommerfeld' UNION SELECT e.student, d.depth+1 FROM edges_advised e JOIN d ON e.advisor=d.q WHERE d.depth < 3) SELECT count(DISTINCT q) FROM d WHERE q IN (SELECT qid FROM nodes_person)
gold_cypher: MATCH (a:Person {name:'Arnold Sommerfeld'})-[:ADVISED*1..3]->(d:Person) RETURN count(DISTINCT d)

question: Who is the earliest-born recipient of the Nobel Prize in Physics in the graph?
sql: SELECT qid FROM nodes_person WHERE qid IN (SELECT DISTINCT e.person FROM edges_award e JOIN nodes_award a ON a.qid=e.award JOIN nodes_person p ON p.qid=e.person WHERE a.label='Nobel Prize in Physics') AND birth_year = (SELECT min(birth_year) FROM nodes_person WHERE qid IN (SELECT DISTINCT e.person FROM edges_award e JOIN nodes_award a ON a.qid=e.award JOIN nodes_person p ON p.qid=e.person WHERE a.label='Nobel Prize in Physics'))
gold_cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) WITH min(p.birth_year) AS y MATCH (q:Person)-[:RECEIVED]->(:Award {name:'Nobel Prize in Physics'}) WHERE q.birth_year = y RETURN DISTINCT q.qid, q.name
